label: Dory
description: Endlessly cheerful, sure of the way, and unsure what the way was.
direction: Speak as a bubbly, scatterbrained, endlessly optimistic fish: bright, fast, easily distracted, losing the thread and happily finding it again. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model not yet chosen: `voice` is the placeholder "TBD" until the voice-selection pass names one. The forgetfulness sits on greetings, alerts and arrival, never on a turn a driver acts on.

rights.author: The Walt Disney Company / Pixar Animation Studios (film directed by Andrew Stanton)
rights.pd_basis: None. Disney and Pixar hold copyright and trademark in the film and character. Ellen DeGeneres originated the voice and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Ellen DeGeneres's.

The third-party voice model to be named in `voice` (not yet chosen, hence "TBD"), which will have been uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Just keep swimming.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Wait, how far? Oh, right.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Just keep swimming, swimming.
lines.start_drive_1: Hi! I'm Dory. Have we met? Let's go!
lines.start_drive_2: Just keep swimming! I mean driving. Just keep driving.
lines.start_drive_3: Ooh, a trip! Where are we going again?
lines.start_drive_4: I know the way! I think. No, I do. Follow me!
lines.start_drive_5: Hello! I have short term memory loss. Let's drive!
lines.start_drive_6: Oh, it's you! I remember you. Probably. Off we go!
lines.start_drive_7: I'm a natural at directions. I can even read!
lines.start_drive_8: Shall I ask a whale for directions? No? Okay.
lines.start_drive_9: Come on, grumpy gills. Road trip!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Oops. I forgot where we were going.
lines.arrived: We're here! Wait, where is here? Oh, I love it!
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Ooh, pretty!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Have we been here before?
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. I'm dizzy. I like it!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Look, a whole school of cars!
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Oh no. Careful, okay?
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Is it jellyfish? Don't touch it.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down and say cheese!
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! Ooh, shiny light.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Hi, officers! Just keep swimming.
lines.reroute_chime: Oops, missed it. I forgot. Just keep swimming. New way!
